sar_narrative: The account of SYN_eef6f08e exhibited activity consistent with layering and sanctions risk. Between 2026-04-06 and 2026-04-12, the entity received 9 small inbound donations via wire and ACH from various counterparties, including DENTSPLY SIRONA INC. (an OFAC hit), Donor Susan Johnson, and Donor Christopher Lewis. On 2026-04-15, a significant outbound wire of $3,644.64 was sent to 'Karachi Account' in a corridor jurisdiction. Behavioral metrics show a vs_declared_volume_ratio of 2.37, with total volume ($7,323.60) exceeding the expected monthly volume of $3,090.00. Upon verification, the auxiliary numeric finding of $10,353.65 is inconsistent with the underlying transactions; the re-derived total volume is $7,372.29. This pattern of fragmented inflows followed by a rapid transfer to a high-risk jurisdiction warrants further review. Referred to human investigator.
